== Notes ==
* In [[Normal mode]], the [[AI]] will only use this skill on a foe wielding a [[martial weapon]] (similar to [[Eruption]] and [[Signet of Midnight]]). In [[Hard mode]], the AI will only use this skill on a [[Martial#Martial details|martial]] primary [[profession]] foe wielding a martial weapon. This is similar to [[Blinding Flash]].  <!--Tested on Afflicted Ranger and Doppelganger-->
** The AI uses this skill on [[spirit]]s which are immune to all conditions except [[burning]].
